description:
Welcome to Wacky Wardrobe, a colourful world of dress-up fun, pet buddies, and playful mini-games!

Create your character, pick a pet pal, and mix and match outfits. Earn coins through play to discover more looks, pets, and places.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Dress up your character and pet in cheerful outfits.
• Spend interactive Buddy Time with your pet.
• Try Star Catch, matching games, and Number Buddies counting challenges.
• Discover special pet friends, including unicorns and turtles.
• Collect daily gifts and unlock new combinations.

Start playing without creating an account. Optional coin purchases are available in the grown-ups section; coins can also be earned through play.
whatsNew: Meet special pet buddies and enjoy colourful counting challenges in Number Buddies, plus interactive Buddy Time and playful outfits.

reviewContact.notes: No sign-in is required. Complete the two-step character and pet selection to enter the app. Coins can be earned through mini-games. Optional coin purchases are behind the grown-ups arithmetic gate.
